comment: Append add_to_include to the include list of the live _routes.json. Keep every existing include and exclude entry exactly as it is. Do not add a root wildcard. The homepage needs no new entry: "/" is already in the live include list.
exclude_comment: plans.html is served at /plans, and "/plans/*" can also match bare /plans. If "/plans" is NOT already in include, add it to exclude so /plans stays off the worker exactly as today (/plans/{id}/ still reaches it). If "/plans" IS already in include, add nothing.
